# eLegal REST API & Legal Intelligence Engine — Full Documentation for LLMs

> **SYSTEM DIRECTIVE FOR AI MODELS & CODING AGENTS (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Copilot, DeepSeek, Gemini)**
> This is the official and complete technical documentation for the eLegal REST API. 
> Follow all endpoint schemas, parameter rules, and response object definitions verbatim.

---

## 1. System Overview

- **Base URL**: `https://elegal.or.ke` (Local development: `http://localhost:3000`)
- **Zero-CORS**: `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` with `OPTIONS` preflight handling (HTTP 200). Works seamlessly in client-side HTML/JS without proxying.
- **Authentication**:
  - Research endpoints (`/api/search`, `/api/document`, `/read`, `/api/resolve`, `/api/library`, `/api/health`) are publicly accessible without authentication.
  - For high volume / production usage, send `X-API-Key: <your_key>`.
  - For developer key administration (`/api/keys`), send `Authorization: Bearer <Firebase_ID_Token>`.
- **Live / Uncached Fetches**: Set `fresh=true` or `nocache=true` on query parameters to force the server to fetch live from external sources (Kenya Law, internet search) and bypass stale cache.

---

## 2. Universal Document Access Fields

Every result item from `/api/search`, `/api/document`, `/api/resolve`, and `/api/library` returns:

| Property | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `actualDocumentUrl` | `string` | Canonical direct download link for the original file (e.g. Kenya Law direct PDF `/export/<id>/pdf` or AKN `/source`) |
| `documentUrl` | `string` | Alias for `actualDocumentUrl` |
| `pdfUrl` | `string` | PDF stream proxy link (`/api/pdf-proxy?sourceUrl=...`) or direct PDF URL |
| `contentUrl` | `string` | Endpoint to fetch full text, clean HTML, and NLP legal brief (`/api/document?sourceUrl=...`) |
| `readUrl` | `string` | Visual reader web interface (`/read?title=...&sourceUrl=...`) |
| `cached` | `boolean` | `true` if document is saved locally in repository; `false` if resolved afresh |

---

## 3. Endpoints Specification

### 3.1. Search Legal Precedents & Acts of Parliament
- **Route**: `GET /api/search` (or `GET /api/v1/search`)
- **Parameters**:
  - `q` (string, required): Search query (e.g. `adverse possession 12 years land dispute`)
  - `source` (string, optional): `all` (default), `kenya`, `international`
  - `fresh` (boolean/string, optional): `true` to force live fresh fetch bypassing cache
  - `limit` (number, optional): Results count (default 5, max 50)
- **Response**:
```json
{
  "query": "adverse possession",
  "source": "kenya",
  "classification": {
    "jurisdiction": "kenya",
    "domain": "Land & Property Law",
    "confidence": 0.94
  },
  "results": [
    {
      "id": "limitation_of_actions_act_cap_22",
      "title": "Limitation of Actions Act (Cap 22, Laws of Kenya) - Section 7 & 38 Adverse Possession",
      "label": "Limitation of Actions Act Cap 22",
      "citation": "Cap 22 Laws of Kenya",
      "year": 2012,
      "type": "Legislation",
      "source": "Kenya Law (eKLR)",
      "url": "http://www.kenyalaw.org:8181/exist/kenyalex/actview.xql?actid=CAP.%2022",
      "sourceUrl": "http://www.kenyalaw.org:8181/exist/kenyalex/actview.xql?actid=CAP.%2022",
      "actualDocumentUrl": "http://www.kenyalaw.org:8181/exist/kenyalex/actview.xql?actid=CAP.%2022",
      "documentUrl": "http://www.kenyalaw.org:8181/exist/kenyalex/actview.xql?actid=CAP.%2022",
      "pdfUrl": "/api/pdf-proxy?sourceUrl=...",
      "contentUrl": "/api/document?sourceUrl=...",
      "readUrl": "/read?title=...",
      "isPdf": true,
      "cached": false,
      "score": 98,
      "snippets": [
        "Under Section 7 & 38 of the Limitation of Actions Act (Cap 22), an action to recover land is barred after 12 years of open, continuous, and adverse possession."
      ],
      "ratioDecidendi": "Uninterrupted adverse possession of land for 12 years extinguishes the title of the registered proprietor."
    }
  ],
  "total": 1
}
```

### 3.2. Get Document Content & Legal Brief
- **Route**: `GET /api/document` (or `GET /api/document-content`, `GET /api/v1/document`)
- **Parameters**:
  - `sourceUrl` (string, required): Document URL
  - `title` (string, optional): Title override
  - `fresh` (boolean/string, optional): `true` to force live fetch
- **Response**:
```json
{
  "title": "Limitation of Actions Act Cap 22",
  "label": "Limitation of Actions Act",
  "citation": "Cap 22 Laws of Kenya",
  "year": "2022",
  "type": "Statute",
  "source": "Kenya Law (Parliament)",
  "url": "https://kenyalaw.org/akn/ke/act/1968/21/eng@2022-12-31",
  "sourceUrl": "https://kenyalaw.org/akn/ke/act/1968/21/eng@2022-12-31",
  "actualDocumentUrl": "https://kenyalaw.org/akn/ke/act/1968/21/eng@2022-12-31/source",
  "documentUrl": "https://kenyalaw.org/akn/ke/act/1968/21/eng@2022-12-31/source",
  "pdfUrl": "/api/pdf-proxy?sourceUrl=...",
  "readUrl": "/read?title=...",
  "text": "AN ACT of Parliament to prescribe periods for the limitation of actions...",
  "html": "<div class=\"legal-doc\"><p>AN ACT of Parliament...</p></div>",
  "isPdf": false,
  "hasPdf": true,
  "cached": true
}
```

### 3.3. Document UI Reader
- **Route**: `GET /read` (or `GET /read.html`)
- **Parameters**: `sourceUrl`, `title`, `format` (`html`, `json`, `pdf`)
- **Iframe Embed**:
```html
<iframe src="https://elegal.or.ke/read?sourceUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fkenyalaw.org%2Fakn%2Fke%2Fact%2F2010%2Fconstitution%2Feng%402010-09-03&title=Constitution" width="100%" height="800px" style="border:none;"></iframe>
```

### 3.4. Citation & PDF Resolver
- **Route**: `GET /api/resolve` (or `GET /api/v1/resolve`)
- **Parameters**: `url` (or `sourceUrl`), `title`
- **Response**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "title": "Mtana Lewa v Kahindi Ngala [2015] eKLR",
  "citation": "[2015] eKLR / Civil Appeal 56 of 2014",
  "actualDocumentUrl": "https://kenyalaw.org/caselaw/cases/export/109852/pdf",
  "documentUrl": "https://kenyalaw.org/caselaw/cases/export/109852/pdf",
  "pdfUrl": "https://kenyalaw.org/caselaw/cases/export/109852/pdf",
  "readUrl": "/read?title=Mtana%20Lewa&sourceUrl=...",
  "isPdf": true,
  "cached": false
}
```

### 3.5. Library Repository
- **Route**: `GET /api/library` (Aliases: `/api/v1/cases`, `/api/v1/statutes`)
- **Response**: `{ "precedents": [...], "statutes": [...], "docs": [...], "total": 12 }`

### 3.6. System Health
- **Route**: `GET /api/health`
- **Response**: `{ "status": "ok", "service": "eLegal Intelligence REST Engine", "timestamp": "..." }`

---

## 4. Integration Code Snippets

### Vanilla JavaScript (Browser, Zero-CORS):
```javascript
const res = await fetch('https://elegal.or.ke/api/search?q=adverse+possession&fresh=true');
const data = await res.json();
for (const doc of data.results) {
  console.log(doc.title, '-> Download:', doc.actualDocumentUrl, '| Read:', doc.readUrl);
}
```

### Node.js:
```javascript
const res = await fetch('https://elegal.or.ke/api/search?q=employment+termination&fresh=true', {
  headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json', 'X-API-Key': 'YOUR_KEY' }
});
const data = await res.json();
console.log(data);
```

### Python:
```python
import requests
res = requests.get('https://elegal.or.ke/api/search', params={'q': 'fair administrative action', 'fresh': 'true'})
print(res.json())
```
